summary: This bill prohibits the imposition of tariffs on imported agricultural inputs, such as seeds, fertilizers, and machinery, from countries with normal trade relations with the U.S. that are higher than the rates in effect on January 19, 2025.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses trade policy by prohibiting additional tariffs on a wide range of agricultural inputs imported from countries with normal trade relations. This action promotes freer trade by reducing barriers (tariffs) on these specific goods, which is the central purpose of the bill.
